messages.content: Write a description, about 70 words, of the last over of a tense gully cricket match.

Six runs needed off the last over, and the whole lane had gone silent. Aman wiped his forehead and gripped the taped tennis ball. Kids crowded the balconies, and even the vegetable seller had stopped to watch. The first ball was a dot. The second went for two. Then Bittu swung hard, and the ball flew over the neighbour's wall. Everyone screamed, half in joy and half in fear. Aunty would definitely not give it back.
Draft a message to a job recruiter thanking her for yesterday's interview. About 70 words. I'm Rohit Malhotra, and I interviewed for a data analyst role.

Dear Ms. Sen,
Thank you for taking the time to interview me yesterday for the Data Analyst position. I enjoyed learning more about your team and the projects you are working on. Our conversation about the customer survey data made me even more excited about the role. I would be happy to share any further information you may need.
Best regards,
Rohit Malhotra
Can you help me thank the neighbour who watered my plants while I was away for two weeks? About 40 words.

Dear Mrs. Khan,
Thank you so much for watering my plants while I was away. They look healthier than when I left! I've brought you some tea from Darjeeling as a small thank-you. I owe you a favour anytime.
Warmly,
Sneha
Our debate is on phones. Write an opening paragraph, about 80 words, showing both the good and bad sides.

Phones have changed the way we live. With one small device, we can call family across the world, look up any fact in seconds and learn new skills for free. For many students, a phone is a window to the world. Yet the same phone can steal hours of our day, disturb our sleep and pull us away from the people sitting right next to us. The real question is not whether phones are good or bad, but whether we control them or they control us.
Write a notice about a free yoga class in the park every Sunday at 6 am, run by a volunteer. About 55 words. Sign it Residents' Welfare Association.

FREE YOGA IN THE PARK

Start your Sunday with calm and cheer. A volunteer teacher will lead a free yoga class in the park every Sunday at 6 am. Everyone is welcome to join, so come along and enjoy a peaceful start to your week. Just come and join us on the grass.

Residents' Welfare Association
Our class is holding a bake sale at school next Wednesday to raise money for the library. Write an invitation, about 50 words, to the whole school.

Come to our bake sale!
Our class invites everyone to a bake sale at school next Wednesday. We have plenty of tasty homemade treats. All the money we raise will go to the library. Please come with your friends and a good appetite. Every bite helps a reader!
Write about 70 words in diary style for a child who saw the sea for the very first time on a family trip.

Dear Diary,
Today I saw the sea for the first time! It was much bigger than I had imagined. The waves rolled in and out, and the water was so blue. I took off my shoes and let the foam tickle my toes. A family member held my hand when a big wave came. I picked up shells and put them in my pocket. I never want to leave.
The school canteen is adding a new snack menu from Monday. Write a short notice, about 35 words, for the board. Sign it Canteen Management.

NOTICE
From Monday, the school canteen will offer a new snack menu. Students are welcome to try the new items during the break. We hope you enjoy them, so do give them a try!
Canteen Management
Please write an email, about 55 words, to a workshop organiser asking about the timings and fees of the weekend photography workshop. I'm Karen.

Subject: Enquiry About the Weekend Photography Workshop

Dear Sir or Madam,
I am interested in joining your weekend photography workshop. Could you please tell me the timings and the fees? Please also let me know how I can register. Thank you for your help. I look forward to your reply.
Best regards,
Karen
Draft a notice, about 45 words, saying that from Monday the swimming pool will be open from 6 am to 8 am and from 5 pm to 7 pm. From the Sports Club.

NOTICE
New Pool Timings
From Monday, the swimming pool will be open from 6 am to 8 am and from 5 pm to 7 pm. Members, please plan your visits accordingly. Thank you for your understanding.
The Sports Club
Draft a paragraph of about 80 words about a machine I would invent to help my grandmother in the kitchen.

If I could invent a machine for my grandmother, it would be a helpful kitchen robot. It would peel vegetables, grind spices and carry heavy pots, so her hands would never get tired. It would also remind her to switch off the gas. But I would make sure it never cooks, because nobody can make dal like my grandmother. The machine would only help, and she would remain the real chef.
Write an eight-line poem about a sleepy village in the afternoon, about 65 words.

The village naps in the afternoon sun,
The lanes are empty, the work is done.
The dog lies down in the shade of the wall,
And the hens are silent, one and all.
A bullock cart creaks, then stops by a tree,
The farmer is dreaming of sweet cold tea.
The breeze goes by with a whispering sound,
And peace lies soft on the sleepy ground.
Quick message to my teammate Hugo, asking him to share the meeting notes by evening. About 30 words, from Priya.

Hi Hugo,
Could you please share the notes from today's meeting by this evening? I would like to read them before tomorrow. Thank you for your help.
Priya
Can I have a short rhyme of eight lines, in pairs, about a clock that is always late? About 65 words.

The clock on the wall is always late,
It ticks along at a sleepy rate.
When morning comes it is still in bed,
While the sun climbs up above its head.
We laugh and tell it to hurry up,
It answers with a yawn and a hiccup.
But who can blame it? It works all day,
And it deserves a break, I would say.
A tiny story of about 50 words about a girl who is afraid to speak in class and finds her voice.

A girl sat at the back and never spoke in class. Her heart pounded whenever the teacher looked at her. One day, the teacher asked a question that she knew well. Slowly, she raised her hand and answered. Her voice shook, but it came out clear. The class clapped, and she smiled.
A funny five-line limerick about an umbrella that hates the rain.

An umbrella who hated the rain
Said, "Every drop gives me a pain!"
He grumbled all day,
Then hid far away,
And wished for the sun on the plain.
Write a notice that a stray puppy has been fed and sheltered in the parking area and neighbours should be gentle. 30 words.

NOTICE
A stray puppy is being fed and sheltered in the parking area. Please be gentle with the little one and do not scare it. Thank you for your kindness.
Diary: the first time I cooked dinner for my family on my own. Around 45 words. I am Jyoti.

Dear Diary,
Today I cooked dinner for my family all by myself. I was nervous, and I burned the first roti. But the dal turned out well, and everyone had a second helping. They smiled and said they were proud. I felt very grown-up tonight.
Jyoti
Library notice, around 40 words: books must come back before the shelves are counted, late books cost five rupees per day, and the reading room must stay silent. Thank readers at the end.

NOTICE
All books must be returned before the shelves are counted. Late books will cost five rupees per day. Please keep silence in the reading room so that everyone can read in peace. Thank you for your cooperation.
Short wedding invitation for relatives: Sunil and Rani are getting married at the lakeside hall on Sunday, the ceremony is at 10 am, and lunch follows. 35 words.

Dear relatives,
Sunil and Rani are getting married at the lakeside hall on Sunday. The ceremony will begin at 10 am, and lunch will follow. We would be very happy if you could attend and bless them.
